reason: Agent dying to melee damage from small monsters at low depth; increasing retreat threshold and adding elbereth-first as an emergency defensive tactic.
diff:

(rule remove tactic_rules 0)

(rule add tactic_rules (when (and (adjacent_hostiles) (hp_frac <= 0.4))) (do elbereth_first) (note "emergency elbereth"))

(rule add tactic_rules (when (adjacent_hostiles)) (do ranged_then_kill))
